description: This PHP source file defines an abstract base class 'AddFormBase' for creating media items within Drupal's media library module. It includes methods for form building, validation, submission, AJAX handling, and media entity management, serving as a foundation for specific media addition forms.

classes.name: AddFormBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for media item creation forms within Drupal's media library, providing core functionalities for form handling, media entity management, and AJAX interactions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form class using dependency injection container.

methods.name: getBaseFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique form ID for this form.

methods.name: getMediaType
methods.description: Retrieves the media type based on form state, loading it from storage if not already set.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the media addition form, including AJAX wrappers, media items, current selection, and actions.

methods.name: buildInputElement
methods.description: Abstract method to build the source input element for creating media items.

methods.name: buildEntityFormElement
methods.description: Builds the sub-form for setting required fields on a new media entity.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of callback methods that can be safely used in pre-rendering.

methods.name: preRenderAddedMedia
methods.description: Converts added media items into a renderable list for display.

methods.name: buildCurrentSelectionArea
methods.description: Builds a render array for the current media selection, if applicable.

methods.name: buildSelectedItemElement
methods.description: Creates a render array for a single pre-selected media item.

methods.name: buildActions
methods.description: Defines the form actions, including save and save-and-insert options.

methods.name: processInputValues
methods.description: Creates media entities from source field input values and updates form state.

methods.name: createMediaFromValue
methods.description: Creates an unsaved media entity from a source value.

methods.name: prepareMediaEntityForSave
methods.description: Hook for preparing a media entity before saving; empty by default.

methods.name: removeButtonSubmit
methods.description: Handles removal of a media item from the form.

methods.name: updateFormCallback
methods.description: AJAX callback to update the form dynamically based on user actions.

methods.name: validateMediaEntity
methods.description: Validates a media entity's form values.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, saving media entities.

methods.name: updateLibrary
methods.description: AJAX callback to add created media to the media library selection.

methods.name: buildMediaLibraryUi
methods.description: Builds the media library UI for selection.

methods.name: updateWidget
methods.description: AJAX callback to send new media to calling widget or close dialog.

methods.name: getSelectedMediaItemCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of selected media items.

methods.name: getMediaLibraryState
methods.description: Retrieves the media library state object from form state.

methods.name: getSourceFieldName
methods.description: Gets the source field name for a media type.

methods.name: getPreSelectedMediaItems
methods.description: Returns pre-selected media items from form state.

methods.name: getAddedMediaItems
methods.description: Returns media items added during form editing.

methods.name: getCurrentMediaItems
methods.description: Returns combined list of pre-selected and added media items.

methods.name: isAdvancedUi
methods.description: Checks if the advanced UI features are enabled.
